Article 250 Whoever publishes content in a publication that discriminates against or insults an ethnic minority, if the circumstances are flagrant and cause serious consequences, the directly liable person shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than three years, criminal detention or public surveillance.

Article 251 Any functionary of a state organ who unlawfully deprives a citizen of his or her freedom of religious belief or infringes upon the customs and habits of an ethnic minority, if the circumstances are serious, shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than two years or criminal detention.

Article 252 Whoever conceals, destroys or unlawfully opens another person's letters, infringing upon a citizen's right to freedom of correspondence, if the circumstances are serious, shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than one year or criminal detention.

Article 253 Any postal worker who, without authorization, opens, conceals or destroys mail or telegrams shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than two years or criminal detention.
Whoever commits the crime mentioned in the preceding paragraph and steals property shall be convicted and given a severe punishment in accordance with the provisions of Article 264 of this Law.
Article 253-1 Whoever, in violation of relevant state regulations, sells or provides citizens' personal information to another person, if the circumstances are serious, shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than three years or criminal detention and shall also, or shall only, be fined; if the circumstances are especially serious, he or she shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than three years but not more than seven years and shall also be fined.
Whoever, in violation of relevant state regulations, sells or provides citizens' personal information obtained during the course of performing duties or providing services to another person shall be given a severe punishment in accordance with the provisions of the preceding paragraph.
Whoever unlawfully obtains citizens' personal information by theft or other means shall be punished in accordance with the provisions of the first paragraph.
Where a unit commits the crime mentioned in the preceding three paragraphs, the unit shall be fined, and the directly responsible person in charge and other directly liable persons shall be punished in accordance with the provisions of the respective paragraphs.

Article 254 Any functionary of a state organ who abuses his or her power or uses public office for private gain to retaliate against or frame a complainant, petitioner, critic or whistleblower shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than two years or criminal detention; if the circumstances are serious, he or she shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than two years but not more than seven years.

Article 255 Any leader of a company, enterprise, institution, organ or organization who, for an accounting or statistical officer who lawfully performs his or her duties and resists acts in violation of the Accounting Law or the Statistics Law, retaliates against such officer, if the circumstances are flagrant, shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than three years or criminal detention.

Article 256 Whoever, during the election of deputies to the People's Congresses at various levels or leaders of state organs, disrupts an election or obstructs voters or deputies from freely exercising their right to vote or stand for election by violence, threat, deception, bribery, falsification of election documents, or false reporting of election votes, if the circumstances are serious, shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than three years, criminal detention or deprivation of political rights.

Article 257 Whoever uses violence to interfere with another person's freedom of marriage shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than two years or criminal detention.
Whoever commits the crime mentioned in the preceding paragraph and causes the death of the victim shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than two years but not more than seven years.
The crime mentioned in the first paragraph shall be handled only upon complaint.

Article 258 Whoever has a spouse and commits bigamy, or knowingly marries another person who has a spouse, shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than two years or criminal detention.

Article 259 Whoever knowingly cohabits with or marries a person who is the spouse of a member of the armed forces on active duty shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than three years or criminal detention.
Whoever, by taking advantage of his or her position or subordinate relationship and by means of coercion, has sexual intercourse with the wife of a member of the armed forces on active duty shall be convicted and punished in accordance with the provisions of Article 236 of this Law.

Article 260 Whoever maltreats a family member, if the circumstances are flagrant, shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than two years, criminal detention or public surveillance.
Whoever commits the crime mentioned in the preceding paragraph and causes serious injury or death to the victim shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than two years but not more than seven years.
The crime mentioned in the first paragraph shall be handled only upon complaint, except where the victim is unable to file a complaint or is unable to file a complaint due to coercion or intimidation.
Article 260-1 Any person who has the duty of guardianship or care for a minor, elderly person, sick person or disabled person and maltreats the person under guardianship or care, if the circumstances are flagrant, shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than three years or criminal detention.
Where a unit commits the crime mentioned in the preceding paragraph, the unit shall be fined, and the directly responsible person in charge and other directly liable persons shall be punished in accordance with the provisions of the preceding paragraph.
Where an act mentioned in the first paragraph also constitutes another crime, the offender shall be convicted and punished in accordance with the provisions for the heavier punishment.

Article 261 Whoever refuses to fulfill his or her duty to support an elderly person, minor, sick person or other person who has no independent means of living, if the circumstances are flagrant, shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than five years, criminal detention or public surveillance.

Article 262 Whoever abducts a minor under the age of 14 away from his or her family or guardian shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than five years or criminal detention.
Article 262-1 Whoever organizes a disabled person or a minor under the age of 14 to beg by violence or coercion shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than three years or criminal detention and shall also be fined; if the circumstances are serious, he or she shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than three years but not more than seven years and shall also be fined.
Article 262-2 Whoever organizes minors to engage in theft, fraud, snatching, extortion or other activities that violate public security administration shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than three years or criminal detention and shall also be fined; if the circumstances are serious, he or she shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than three years but not more than seven years and shall also be fined.

Article 264 Whoever steals public or private property in a relatively large amount, or repeatedly steals property, enters a residence to steal property, carries a lethal weapon to steal property, or pickpockets property, shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than three years, criminal detention or public surveillance and shall also, or shall only, be fined; whoever steals property in a huge amount or under other serious circumstances shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than three years but not more than ten years and shall also be fined; whoever steals property in an especially huge amount or under other especially serious circumstances shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than ten years or life imprisonment and shall also be fined or have his or her property confiscated.

Article 265 Whoever, for the purpose of profit, illicitly connects to another person's communication line, copies another person's telecommunication code number, or knowingly uses telecommunication equipment or facilities that have been illicitly connected or copied shall be convicted and punished in accordance with the provisions of Article 264 of this Law.

Article 266 Whoever defrauds public or private property in a relatively large amount shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than three years, criminal detention or public surveillance and shall also, or shall only, be fined; whoever defrauds property in a huge amount or under other serious circumstances shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than three years but not more than ten years and shall also be fined; whoever defrauds property in an especially huge amount or under other especially serious circumstances shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than ten years or life imprisonment and shall also be fined or have his or her property confiscated. Where this Law provides otherwise, such provisions shall prevail.

Article 267 Whoever forcibly seizes public or private property in a relatively large amount, or repeatedly seizes property, shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than three years, criminal detention or public surveillance and shall also, or shall only, be fined; whoever seizes property in a huge amount or under other serious circumstances shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than three years but not more than ten years and shall also be fined; whoever seizes property in an especially huge amount or under other especially serious circumstances shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than ten years or life imprisonment and shall also be fined or have his or her property confiscated.
Whoever carries a lethal weapon to seize property shall be convicted and punished in accordance with the provisions of Article 263 of this Law.

Article 268 Whoever gathers a crowd to forcibly seize public or private property, if the amount is relatively large or there are other serious circumstances, the ringleader and active participants shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than three years, criminal detention or public surveillance and shall also be fined; if the amount is huge or there are other especially serious circumstances, they shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than three years but not more than ten years and shall also be fined.

Article 269 Whoever commits the crime of theft, fraud or forcible seizure and, on the spot, uses violence or threatens to use violence to conceal stolen goods, resist arrest or destroy criminal evidence shall be convicted and punished in accordance with the provisions of Article 263 of this Law.

Article 270 Whoever unlawfully takes possession of another person's property that is in his or her custody, if the amount is relatively large and he or she refuses to return it, shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than two years, criminal detention or a fine; if the amount is huge or there are other serious circumstances, he or she shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than two years but not more than five years and shall also be fined.
Whoever unlawfully takes possession of another person's lost property or buried property, if the amount is relatively large and he or she refuses to hand it over, shall be punished in accordance with the provisions of the preceding paragraph.
The crime mentioned in this Article shall be handled only upon complaint.

Article 271 Any staff member of a company, enterprise or other unit who, by taking advantage of his or her position, unlawfully takes possession of the property of the unit, if the amount is relatively large, shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than three years or criminal detention and shall also be fined; if the amount is huge, he or she shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than three years but not more than ten years and shall also be fined; if the amount is especially huge, he or she shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than ten years or life imprisonment and shall also be fined.
Any person who performs public duties in a state-owned company, enterprise or other state-owned unit, or any person who is assigned by a state-owned company, enterprise or other state-owned unit to a non-state-owned company, enterprise or other unit to perform public duties, who commits the act mentioned in the preceding paragraph shall be convicted and punished in accordance with the provisions of Articles 382 and 383 of this Law.

Article 272 Any staff member of a company, enterprise or other unit who, by taking advantage of his or her position, misappropriates the funds of the unit for personal use or lends them to another person, if the amount is relatively large and he or she fails to repay it within three months, or if the amount is relatively large and he or she uses them for profit-making activities, or if he or she uses them for illegal activities, shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than three years or criminal detention; if the amount of misappropriated funds is huge, he or she shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than three years but not more than seven years; if the amount is especially huge, he or she shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than seven years.
Any person who performs public duties in a state-owned company, enterprise or other state-owned unit, or any person who is assigned by a state-owned company, enterprise or other state-owned unit to a non-state-owned company, enterprise or other unit to perform public duties, who commits the act mentioned in the preceding paragraph shall be convicted and punished in accordance with the provisions of Article 384 of this Law.
Where a person commits the act mentioned in the first paragraph and returns the misappropriated funds before a public prosecution is initiated, he or she may be given a lighter or mitigated punishment. If the crime is minor, he or she may be given a mitigated punishment or exempted from punishment.

Article 273 Whoever misappropriates materials allocated for emergency relief, disaster relief, flood control, social assistance, poverty alleviation, resettlement or social aid, if the circumstances are serious and cause significant damage to the interests of the state and the people, the directly liable person shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than three years or criminal detention; if the circumstances are especially serious, he or she shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than three years but not more than seven years.

Article 274 Whoever extorts public or private property, if the amount is relatively large or the extortion is committed repeatedly, shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than three years, criminal detention or public surveillance and shall also, or shall only, be fined; if the amount is huge or there are other serious circumstances, he or she shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than three years but not more than ten years and shall also be fined; if the amount is especially huge or there are other especially serious circumstances, he or she shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than ten years and shall also be fined.

Article 275 Whoever intentionally destroys public or private property, if the amount is relatively large or there are other serious circumstances, shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than three years, criminal detention or a fine; if the amount is huge or there are other especially serious circumstances, he or she shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than three years but not more than seven years.

Article 276 Whoever, out of resentment or revenge or for other personal purposes, destroys machinery or equipment, injures or kills draft animals, or otherwise disrupts production or business operations, shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than three years, criminal detention or public surveillance; if the circumstances are serious, he or she shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than three years but not more than seven years.
Article 276-1 Whoever evades paying labor remuneration to workers by transferring property or absconding, or refuses to pay labor remuneration even though he or she has the ability to do so, if the amount is relatively large and he or she still fails to pay after being ordered to do so by the relevant government department, shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than three years or criminal detention and shall also, or shall only, be fined; if serious consequences are caused, he or she shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than three years but not more than seven years and shall also be fined.
Where a unit commits the crime mentioned in the preceding paragraph, the unit shall be fined, and the directly responsible person in charge and other directly liable persons shall be punished in accordance with the provisions of the preceding paragraph.
Where the acts mentioned in the preceding two paragraphs have not caused serious consequences, and the offender pays the labor remuneration to the workers before a public prosecution is initiated and bears the corresponding liability for compensation according to law, he or she may be given a mitigated punishment or exempted from punishment.

Article 277 Whoever, by means of violence or threat, obstructs a functionary of a state organ from performing his or her duties according to law shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than three years, criminal detention, public surveillance or a fine.
Whoever, by means of violence or threat, obstructs a deputy to the National People's Congress or a local People's Congress at any level from performing his or her duties as a deputy according to law shall be punished in accordance with the provisions of the preceding paragraph.
Whoever, during a natural disaster or an emergency, obstructs a staff member of the Red Cross Society from performing his or her duties according to law by means of violence or threat shall be punished in accordance with the provisions of the first paragraph.
Whoever intentionally obstructs a state security organ or a public security organ from performing its tasks of safeguarding state security according to law, without resorting to violence or threat, and causes serious consequences, shall be punished in accordance with the provisions of the first paragraph.
Whoever violently assaults a People's Police officer who is lawfully performing his or her duties shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than three years, criminal detention or public surveillance; whoever uses a firearm, controlled cutting tool, or means such as driving a motor vehicle to ram into the officer, seriously endangering his or her personal safety, shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than three years but not more than seven years.

Article 278 Whoever incites a crowd to violently resist the implementation of national laws or administrative regulations shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than three years, criminal detention, public surveillance or deprivation of political rights; if serious consequences are caused, he or she shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than three years but not more than seven years.

Article 279 Whoever impersonates a functionary of a state organ to swindle and deceive shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than three years, criminal detention, public surveillance or deprivation of political rights; if the circumstances are serious, he or she shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than three years but not more than ten years.
Whoever impersonates a People's Police officer to swindle and deceive shall be given a severe punishment in accordance with the provisions of the preceding paragraph.

Article 280 Whoever forges, alters, buys or sells, or steals, robs or destroys official documents, certificates or seals of a state organ shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than three years, criminal detention, public surveillance or deprivation of political rights and shall also be fined; if the circumstances are serious, he or she shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than three years but not more than ten years and shall also be fined.
Whoever forges seals of a company, enterprise, institution or people's organization shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than three years, criminal detention, public surveillance or deprivation of political rights and shall also be fined.
Whoever forges, alters, buys or sells resident identity cards, passports, social security cards, driver's licenses or other identity documents that may be used according to law to prove identity shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than three years, criminal detention, public surveillance or deprivation of political rights and shall also be fined; if the circumstances are serious, he or she shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than three years but not more than seven years and shall also be fined.
Article 280-1 Whoever, in an activity that requires the provision of identity documents according to state regulations, uses forged or altered identity documents, or fraudulently uses another person's resident identity card, passport, social security card, driver's license or other identity documents that may be used according to law to prove identity, if the circumstances are serious, shall be sentenced to criminal detention or public surveillance and shall also, or shall only, be fined.
Where an act mentioned in the preceding paragraph also constitutes another crime, the offender shall be convicted and punished in accordance with the provisions for the heavier punishment.
Article 280-2 Whoever fraudulently uses or usurps another person's identity to usurp the other person's qualifications for higher education admission, civil service recruitment or employment placement benefits shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than three years, criminal detention or public surveillance and shall also be fined.
Whoever organizes or instructs another person to commit the act mentioned in the preceding paragraph shall be given a severe punishment in accordance with the provisions of the preceding paragraph.
Where a state functionary commits the acts mentioned in the preceding two paragraphs and also constitutes another crime, he or she shall be punished in accordance with the provisions on combined punishment for several crimes.

Article 281: Whoever unlawfully produces or sells the uniforms, vehicle license plates and other special symbols, or police equipment of the People's Police, where the circumstances are serious, shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than three years, criminal detention, or public surveillance, and/or a fine.
Where a unit commits the crime in the preceding paragraph, a fine shall be imposed on the unit, and the persons directly in charge and other persons directly responsible shall be punished in accordance with the provisions of the preceding paragraph.

Article 282: Whoever unlawfully obtains State secrets by theft, espionage, or purchase shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than three years, criminal detention, public surveillance, or deprivation of political rights; where the circumstances are serious, shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than three years but not more than seven years.
Whoever unlawfully holds documents, materials, or other articles classified as top secret or secret of the State and refuses to explain their source or purpose shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than three years, criminal detention, or public surveillance.

Article 283: Whoever unlawfully produces or sells special espionage equipment or special equipment for eavesdropping or surreptitious photography shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than three years, criminal detention, or public surveillance, and/or a fine; where the circumstances are serious, shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than three years but not more than seven years, and a fine.
Where a unit commits the crime in the preceding paragraph, a fine shall be imposed on the unit, and the persons directly in charge and other persons directly responsible shall be punished in accordance with the provisions of the preceding paragraph.

Article 284: Whoever unlawfully uses special equipment for eavesdropping or surreptitious photography, causing serious consequences, shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than two years, criminal detention, or public surveillance.
Article 284(A): Whoever organizes cheating in a national examination prescribed by law shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than three years or criminal detention, and/or a fine; where the circumstances are serious, shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than three years but not more than seven years, and a fine.
Whoever provides cheating equipment or other assistance to another person for committing the crime in the preceding paragraph shall be punished in accordance with the provisions of the preceding paragraph.
Whoever, for the purpose of carrying out examination cheating, unlawfully sells or provides to another person the questions or answers of the examination specified in paragraph 1 shall be punished in accordance with the provisions of paragraph 1.
Whoever takes an examination on behalf of another person or causes another person to take an examination on his behalf, in respect of the examination specified in paragraph 1, shall be sentenced to criminal detention or public surveillance, and/or a fine.

Article 285: Whoever, in violation of State regulations, intrudes into a computer information system concerning State affairs, national defense construction, or cutting-edge science and technology shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than three years or criminal detention.
Whoever, in violation of State regulations, intrudes into a computer information system other than those specified in the preceding paragraph, or adopts other technical means to obtain data stored, processed, or transmitted in such a computer information system, or illegally controls such a computer information system, where the circumstances are serious, shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than three years or criminal detention, and/or a fine; where the circumstances are particularly serious, shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than three years but not more than seven years, and a fine.
Whoever provides programs or tools specifically used for intruding into or illegally controlling computer information systems, or provides programs or tools to another person who, as known to the provider, is committing an illegal or criminal act of intruding into or illegally controlling a computer information system, where the circumstances are serious, shall be punished in accordance with the provisions of the preceding paragraph.
Where a unit commits any of the crimes in the preceding three paragraphs, a fine shall be imposed on the unit, and the persons directly in charge and other persons directly responsible shall be punished in accordance with the provisions of each respective paragraph.

Article 286: Whoever, in violation of State regulations, deletes, modifies, adds, or interferes with the functions of a computer information system, causing the system to fail to operate normally, where the consequences are serious, shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than five years or criminal detention; where the consequences are particularly serious, shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than five years.
Whoever, in violation of State regulations, performs operations of deleting, modifying, or adding on the data and application programs stored, processed, or transmitted in a computer information system, where the consequences are serious, shall be punished in accordance with the provisions of the preceding paragraph.
Whoever intentionally creates or spreads destructive programs such as computer viruses, affecting the normal operation of a computer system, where the consequences are serious, shall be punished in accordance with the provisions of paragraph 1.
Where a unit commits any of the crimes in the preceding three paragraphs, a fine shall be imposed on the unit, and the persons directly in charge and other persons directly responsible shall be punished in accordance with the provisions of paragraph 1.
Article 286(A): Where a network service provider fails to perform the information network security management obligations prescribed by laws and administrative regulations, and, after being ordered by a regulatory authority to take corrective measures, refuses to do so, and falls under any of the following circumstances, it shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than three years, criminal detention, or public surveillance, and/or a fine:
(1) causing illegal information to be disseminated on a large scale;
(2) causing user information to be leaked, resulting in serious consequences;
(3) causing the loss of evidence in a criminal case, where the circumstances are serious; or
(4) having other serious circumstances.
Where a unit commits the crime in the preceding paragraph, a fine shall be imposed on the unit, and the persons directly in charge and other persons directly responsible shall be punished in accordance with the provisions of the preceding paragraph.
Where the acts in the preceding two paragraphs simultaneously constitute other crimes, the person shall be convicted and punished in accordance with the provisions on the heavier punishment.

Article 287: Whoever uses a computer to commit crimes such as financial fraud, theft, embezzlement, misappropriation of public funds, or theft of State secrets shall be convicted and punished in accordance with the relevant provisions of this Law.
Article 287(A): Whoever uses an information network to commit any of the following acts, where the circumstances are serious, shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than three years or criminal detention, and/or a fine:
(1) establishing websites or communication groups for committing illegal or criminal activities such as fraud, teaching criminal methods, or producing or selling prohibited or controlled articles;
(2) publishing information concerning the production or sale of drugs, firearms, pornographic articles or other prohibited or controlled articles, or other illegal or criminal information; or
(3) publishing information for committing illegal or criminal activities such as fraud.
Where a unit commits the crime in the preceding paragraph, a fine shall be imposed on the unit, and the persons directly in charge and other persons directly responsible shall be punished in accordance with the provisions of paragraph 1.
Where the acts in the preceding two paragraphs simultaneously constitute other crimes, the person shall be convicted and punished in accordance with the provisions on the heavier punishment.
Article 287(B): Whoever, knowing that another person is using an information network to commit a crime, provides technical support such as Internet access, server hosting, network storage, or communication transmission for his crime, or provides assistance such as advertising promotion or payment settlement, where the circumstances are serious, shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than three years or criminal detention, and/or a fine.
Where a unit commits the crime in the preceding paragraph, a fine shall be imposed on the unit, and the persons directly in charge and other persons directly responsible shall be punished in accordance with the provisions of paragraph 1.
Where the acts in the preceding two paragraphs simultaneously constitute other crimes, the person shall be convicted and punished in accordance with the provisions on the heavier punishment.

Article 288: Whoever, in violation of State regulations, sets up or uses a radio station (or stations) without authorization, or uses radio frequencies without authorization, thereby interfering with the order of radio communications, where the circumstances are serious, shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than three years, criminal detention, or public surveillance, and/or a fine; where the circumstances are particularly serious, shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than three years but not more than seven years, and a fine.
Where a unit commits the crime in the preceding paragraph, a fine shall be imposed on the unit, and the persons directly in charge and other persons directly responsible shall be punished in accordance with the provisions of the preceding paragraph.

Article 289: Where a crowd gathered for "beating, smashing, and looting" causes injury or death to any person, the offenders shall be convicted and punished in accordance with Articles 234 and 232 of this Law. Any destruction or seizure of public or private property shall, in addition to an order for restitution, result in the principal offenders being convicted and punished in accordance with Article 263 of this Law.

Article 290: Where a crowd gathered to disturb public order, where the circumstances are serious and cause work, production, business operations, teaching, scientific research, or medical treatment to be unable to proceed, resulting in serious losses, the principal offenders shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than three years but not more than seven years; other active participants shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than three years, criminal detention, public surveillance, or deprivation of political rights.
Where a crowd gathered to assault a State organ, causing its work to be unable to proceed, resulting in serious losses, the principal offenders shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than five years but not more than ten years; other active participants shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than five years, criminal detention, public surveillance, or deprivation of political rights.
Whoever repeatedly disturbs the work order of a State organ and, after receiving an administrative penalty, still fails to correct the behavior, and causes serious consequences, shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than three years, criminal detention, or public surveillance.
Whoever repeatedly organizes or funds others to engage in illegal gatherings, thereby disturbing public order, where the circumstances are serious, shall be punished in accordance with the provisions of the preceding paragraph.

Article 291: Where a crowd gathered to disturb order at railway stations, wharves, civil aviation stations, shopping malls, parks, theaters, exhibition centers, sports grounds, or other public places, to block traffic or destroy traffic order, or to resist or obstruct State public security administration personnel from lawfully performing their duties, where the circumstances are serious, the principal offenders shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than five years, criminal detention, or public surveillance.
Article 291(A): Whoever releases false substances such as explosive, toxic, radioactive, or infectious disease pathogens, or fabricates terrorist information such as explosive threats, biochemical threats, or radiation threats, or knowingly disseminates fabricated terrorist information, thereby seriously disturbing public order, shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than five years, criminal detention, or public surveillance; where serious consequences are caused, shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than five years.
Whoever fabricates false information about dangers, epidemics, disasters, or alerts, and disseminates it on information networks or other media, or knowingly disseminates the aforesaid false information on information networks or other media, thereby seriously disturbing public order, shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than three years, criminal detention, or public surveillance; where serious consequences are caused, shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than three years but not more than seven years.
Article 291(B): Whoever throws objects from a building or other heights, where the circumstances are serious, shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than one year, criminal detention, or public surveillance, and/or a fine.
Where the act in the preceding paragraph simultaneously constitutes another crime, the person shall be convicted and punished in accordance with the provisions on the heavier punishment.

Article 294: Whoever organizes or leads a mafia-type organization shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than seven years and confiscation of property; whoever actively participates in such an organization shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than three years but not more than seven years, and may also be fined or have his property confiscated; other participants shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than three years, criminal detention, public surveillance, or deprivation of political rights, and may also be fined.
Where personnel of a mafia-type organization from outside the territory develop organization members within the territory of the People's Republic of China, they shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than three years but not more than ten years.
Any functionary of a State organ who harbors a mafia-type organization or connives at its illegal or criminal activities shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than five years; where the circumstances are serious, shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than five years.
Where a person commits any of the crimes in the preceding three paragraphs and also commits other crimes, he shall be punished in accordance with the provisions on combined punishment for multiple crimes.
A mafia-type organization shall simultaneously possess the following characteristics:
(1) It has formed a relatively stable criminal organization with a relatively large number of members, clear organizers and leaders, and basically fixed core members;
(2) It systematically obtains economic benefits through illegal or criminal activities or other means, has a certain economic strength to support the organization's activities;
(3) It systematically commits illegal or criminal acts multiple times through violence, threats, or other means, doing evil, oppressing, and harming the masses; and
(4) Through committing illegal or criminal acts, or by taking advantage of the harboring or connivance of State functionaries, it dominates a certain area, forming illegal control or significant influence in a specific region or industry, thereby seriously undermining economic and social order.

Article 295: Whoever teaches criminal methods shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than five years, criminal detention, or public surveillance; where the circumstances are serious, shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than five years but not more than ten years; where the circumstances are particularly serious, shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than ten years or life imprisonment.

Article 296: Where an assembly, procession, or demonstration is held without an application having been made in accordance with the provisions of the law, or without the application having been approved, or without being conducted in accordance with the start and end times, locations, and routes approved by the competent authority, and the order to disperse is disobeyed, thereby seriously disrupting public order, the person in charge and the persons directly responsible for the assembly, procession, or demonstration shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than five years, criminal detention, public surveillance, or deprivation of political rights.

Article 297: Whoever, in violation of the provisions of the law, carries weapons, controlled knives, or explosives while participating in an assembly, procession, or demonstration shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than three years, criminal detention, public surveillance, or deprivation of political rights.

Article 298: Whoever disturbs, assaults, or otherwise disrupts an assembly, procession, or demonstration held in accordance with the law, thereby causing public disorder, shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than five years, criminal detention, public surveillance, or deprivation of political rights.

Article 299: Whoever intentionally insults the national flag or national emblem of the People's Republic of China in a public place by burning, damaging, defacing, soiling, trampling, or other means shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than three years, criminal detention, public surveillance, or deprivation of political rights.
Whoever intentionally distorts the lyrics or sheet music of the national anthem of the People's Republic of China in a public place, plays or sings the national anthem in a distorted or derogatory manner, or insults the national anthem by other means, where the circumstances are serious, shall be punished in accordance with the provisions of the preceding paragraph.
Article 299(A): Whoever insults, slanders, or otherwise infringes upon the reputation or honor of heroes or martyrs, thereby harming the public interest, where the circumstances are serious, shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than three years, criminal detention, public surveillance, or deprivation of political rights.

Article 300: Whoever organizes or uses superstitious sects, cult organizations, or exploits superstition to undermine the implementation of State laws and administrative regulations shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than three years but not more than seven years, and a fine; where the circumstances are particularly serious, shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than seven years or life imprisonment, and a fine or confiscation of property; where the circumstances are relatively minor, shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than three years, criminal detention, public surveillance, or deprivation of political rights, and/or a fine.
Whoever organizes or uses superstitious sects, cult organizations, or exploits superstition to deceive others, causing serious injury or death, shall be punished in accordance with the provisions of the preceding paragraph.
Where a person commits the crime in paragraph 1 and also commits other crimes such as raping a woman or defrauding property, he shall be punished in accordance with the provisions on combined punishment for multiple crimes.

Article 301: Whoever assembles a crowd to engage in licentious activities shall, if he/she is a ringleader or repeatedly participates, be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than five years, criminal detention, or public surveillance.
Whoever lures a minor to participate in such activities shall be given a severe punishment in accordance with the provisions of the preceding paragraph.

Article 302: Whoever steals, insults, or intentionally destroys a corpse, skeleton, or ashes shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than three years, criminal detention, or public surveillance.

Article 303: Whoever, for the purpose of profit, assembles a crowd to gamble or makes a living from gambling shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than three years, criminal detention, or public surveillance, and shall also be fined.
Whoever opens a casino shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than five years, criminal detention, or public surveillance, and shall also be fined; if the circumstances are serious, the person shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than five years but not more than ten years, and shall also be fined.
Whoever organizes citizens of the People's Republic of China to participate in gambling abroad (or from a foreign country), where the amount involved is huge or there are other serious circumstances, shall be punished in accordance with the provisions of the preceding paragraph.

Article 304: Any postal employee who, being seriously irresponsible, intentionally delays the delivery of mail, thereby causing heavy losses to public property, the state, or the interests of the people, shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than two years or criminal detention.

Article 305: In a criminal action, a witness, expert evaluator, recorder, or translator who, with intent to frame another person or conceal criminal evidence, intentionally makes a false certification, evaluation, record, or translation concerning matters having an important bearing on a case shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than three years or criminal detention; if the circumstances are serious, the person shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than three years but not more than seven years.

Article 306: In a criminal action, a defender or litigation agent who destroys or forges evidence, assists a party to destroy or forge evidence, or threatens or induces a witness to alter testimony contrary to facts or to give false testimony shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than three years or criminal detention; if the circumstances are serious, the person shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than three years but not more than seven years.
Where witness testimony or other evidence provided, presented, or cited by a defender or litigation agent is inaccurate but is not intentionally forged, it shall not be deemed as forged evidence.

Article 307: Whoever, by means of violence, threats, bribery, or other methods, prevents a witness from testifying or instigates another to give false testimony shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than three years or criminal detention; if the circumstances are serious, the person shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than three years but not more than seven years.
Whoever assists a party in destroying or forging evidence, if the circumstances are serious, shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than three years or criminal detention.
Any judicial officer who commits any of the crimes prescribed in the preceding two paragraphs shall be given a severe punishment.
Article 307A: Whoever brings a civil action based on fabricated facts, thereby disrupting judicial order or seriously infringing upon the lawful rights and interests of others, shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than three years, criminal detention, or public surveillance, and shall also, or shall only, be fined; if the circumstances are serious, the person shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than three years but not more than seven years, and shall also be fined.
Where a unit commits the crime in the preceding paragraph, the unit shall be fined, and the person directly in charge and other persons directly responsible shall be punished in accordance with the provisions of the preceding paragraph.
If any person who commits the act described in the first paragraph illegally misappropriates the property of another person or evades lawful debts, and such act also constitutes any other crime, the person shall be convicted and given a severe punishment in accordance with the provisions on the heavier punishment.
Any judicial officer who, taking advantage of his/her position, jointly commits any of the acts described in the preceding three paragraphs with another person shall be given a severe punishment; if such act also constitutes any other crime, the person shall be convicted and given a severe punishment in accordance with the provisions on the heavier punishment.

Article 308: Whoever retaliates against a witness shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than three years or criminal detention; if the circumstances are serious, the person shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than three years but not more than seven years.
Article 308A: Any judicial officer, defender, litigation agent, or other participant in a proceeding who divulges information that shall not be disclosed in a case tried in camera according to law, thereby causing the information to be publicly disseminated or causing other serious consequences, shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than three years, criminal detention, or public surveillance, and shall also, or shall only, be fined.
Where the act described in the preceding paragraph divulges state secrets, the person shall be convicted and punished in accordance with the provisions of Article 398 of this Law.
Whoever publicly discloses or reports the case information specified in the first paragraph, if the circumstances are serious, shall be punished in accordance with the provisions of the first paragraph.
Where a unit commits the crime in the preceding paragraph, the unit shall be fined, and the person directly in charge and other persons directly responsible shall be punished in accordance with the provisions of the first paragraph.

Article 310: Whoever knowingly provides a hiding place or property to a criminal, assists the person to escape, or makes false testimony to shield the person shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than three years, criminal detention, or public surveillance; if the circumstances are serious, the person shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than three years but not more than ten years.
Whoever commits the crime in the preceding paragraph and conspired with the criminal before the commission of the crime shall be dealt with as an accomplice.

Article 311: Whoever, knowing that another person has committed a crime of espionage, terrorism, or extremism, refuses to provide relevant information or evidence when a judicial organ investigates the matter or collects relevant evidence, if the circumstances are serious, shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than three years, criminal detention, or public surveillance.

Article 312: Whoever harbors, transfers, purchases, sells on behalf of another person, or conceals or disguises by other means property known to be proceeds of crime or income generated therefrom shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than three years, criminal detention, or public surveillance, and shall also, or shall only, be fined; if the circumstances are serious, the person shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than three years but not more than seven years, and shall also be fined.
Where a unit commits the crime in the preceding paragraph, the unit shall be fined, and the person directly in charge and other persons directly responsible shall be punished in accordance with the provisions of the preceding paragraph.

Article 313: Whoever has the capacity to enforce a judgment or order of a People's Court but refuses to do so, if the circumstances are serious, shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than three years, criminal detention, or a fine; if the circumstances are particularly serious, the person shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than three years but not more than seven years, and shall also be fined.
Where a unit commits the crime in the preceding paragraph, the unit shall be fined, and the person directly in charge and other persons directly responsible shall be punished in accordance with the provisions of the preceding paragraph.

Article 314: Whoever conceals, transfers, sells, or intentionally damages or destroys property that has been sealed up, sequestered, or frozen by a judicial organ, if the circumstances are serious, shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than three years, criminal detention, or a fine.

Article 316: Any criminal, defendant, or criminal suspect lawfully detained who escapes from custody shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than five years or criminal detention.
Whoever forcibly takes a criminal, defendant, or criminal suspect who is being escorted shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than three years but not more than seven years; if the circumstances are serious, the person shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than seven years.

Article 317: Ringleaders who organize a jailbreak and those who actively participate shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than five years; other participants shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than five years or criminal detention.
Ringleaders who mutinously escape from prison or riotously storm a prison with weapons and those who actively participate shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than ten years or life imprisonment; if the circumstances are especially serious, the person shall be sentenced to the death penalty; other participants shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than three years but not more than ten years.

Article 319: Whoever, in the name of labor export, economic or trade exchanges, or any other pretext, practices fraud to obtain passports, visas, or other exit documents for the purpose of organizing others to illegally cross the national border (or frontier) shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than three years, and shall also be fined; if the circumstances are serious, the person shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than three years but not more than ten years, and shall also be fined.
Where a unit commits the crime in the preceding paragraph, the unit shall be fined, and the person directly in charge and other persons directly responsible shall be punished in accordance with the provisions of the preceding paragraph.

Article 320: Whoever provides another person with a forged or altered passport, visa, or other entry or exit document, or sells a passport, visa, or other entry or exit document shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than five years, and shall also be fined; if the circumstances are serious, the person shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than five years, and shall also be fined.

Article 322 Whoever violates the State regulations on administration of national borders (borders) and illegally crosses the national border (border), if the circumstances are serious, shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than one year, criminal detention or public surveillance, and shall be fined; if, for the purpose of participating in a terrorist organization, receiving terrorist activity training or committing terrorist activities, he illegally crosses the national border (border), he shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than one year but not more than three years, and shall be fined.

Article 323 Whoever intentionally destroys the boundary tablets, boundary markers or permanent survey markers of the national border shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than three years or criminal detention.

Article 324 Whoever intentionally damages valuable cultural relics under State protection or cultural relics that are determined to be major cultural relics sites under State protection or provincial-level cultural relics sites shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than three years or criminal detention, and shall also be fined or only be fined; if the circumstances are serious, he shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than three years but not more than ten years, and shall be fined.
Whoever intentionally damages famous historical and scenic sites under State protection, if the circumstances are serious, shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than five years or criminal detention, and shall also be fined or only be fined.
Whoever negligently damages valuable cultural relics under State protection or cultural relics that are determined to be major cultural relics sites under State protection or provincial-level cultural relics sites, causing serious consequences, shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than three years or criminal detention.

Article 325 Whoever, in violation of the regulations on protection of cultural relics, privately sells or privately presents to a foreigner a valuable cultural relic in his collection that is prohibited by the State from being exported shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than five years or criminal detention, and may also be fined.
If a unit commits the crime as set forth in the preceding paragraph, it shall be fined, and the persons who are directly in charge and the other persons who are directly liable for the crime shall be punished in accordance with the provisions of the preceding paragraph.

Article 326 Whoever, for the purpose of profit, resells cultural relics that are prohibited by the State from being traded, if the circumstances are serious, shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than five years or criminal detention, and shall be fined; if the circumstances are especially serious, he shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than five years but not more than ten years, and shall be fined.
If a unit commits the crime as set forth in the preceding paragraph, it shall be fined, and the persons who are directly in charge and the other persons who are directly liable for the crime shall be punished in accordance with the provisions of the preceding paragraph.

Article 327 If, in violation of the regulations on protection of cultural relics, a State-owned museum, library or other unit sells or privately gives the cultural relics in its collection that are under State protection to a non-State-owned unit or individual, the unit shall be fined, and the persons who are directly in charge and the other persons who are directly liable for the crime shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than three years or criminal detention.

Article 329 Whoever forcibly seizes or steals archives that are owned by the State shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than five years or criminal detention.
Whoever, in violation of the Archives Law, sells or transfers archives that are owned by the State without authorization, if the circumstances are serious, shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than three years or criminal detention.
If a person commits the acts as set forth in the preceding two paragraphs and such acts also constitute other crimes provided for in this Law, he shall be convicted and punished in accordance with the provisions on the heavier punishment.

Article 331 If a person engaged in the experiment, storage, carrying or transportation of bacterial strains and virus strains of infectious diseases violates the relevant regulations of the health administration department under the State Council and causes the spread of bacterial strains or virus strains of infectious diseases, if the consequences are serious, he shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than three years or criminal detention; if the consequences are especially serious, he shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than three years but not more than seven years.

Article 332 Whoever, in violation of the regulations on frontier health and quarantine, causes the spread of a quarantinable infectious disease or causes a serious risk of spread thereof shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than three years or criminal detention, and shall also be fined or only be fined.
If a unit commits the crime as set forth in the preceding paragraph, it shall be fined, and the persons who are directly in charge and the other persons who are directly liable for the crime shall be punished in accordance with the provisions of the preceding paragraph.

Article 333 Whoever illegally organizes another person to sell blood shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than five years and shall be fined; whoever compels another person to sell blood by violence or threat shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than five years but not more than ten years, and shall be fined.
If the act as set forth in the preceding paragraph causes injury to another person, the offender shall be convicted and punished in accordance with the provisions of Article 234 of this Law.

Article 334 Whoever illegally collects or supplies blood or produces or supplies blood products that fail to meet the standards prescribed by the State and that are sufficient to endanger human health shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than five years or criminal detention, and shall be fined; if the act causes serious harm to human health, he shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than five years but not more than ten years, and shall be fined; if the act causes especially serious consequences, he shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than ten years or life imprisonment, and shall be fined or have his property confiscated.
If a department that is approved by the competent department of the State to collect or supply blood or to produce or supply blood products fails to conduct testing in accordance with the provisions or violates other operating procedures, thereby causing consequences of endangering another person's health, the unit shall be fined, and the persons who are directly in charge and the other persons who are directly liable for the crime shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than five years or criminal detention.
Article 334a Whoever, in violation of the relevant regulations of the State, illegally collects human genetic resources of our country or illegally transports, mails or carries out of the country materials of human genetic resources of our country, thereby endangering public health or public interests, if the circumstances are serious, shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than three years, criminal detention or public surveillance, and shall also be fined or only be fined; if the circumstances are especially serious, he shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than three years but not more than seven years, and shall be fined.

Article 335 If a medical worker, due to serious irresponsibility, causes the death of a patient or seriously impairs the health of a patient, he shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than three years or criminal detention.

Article 336 Whoever, without obtaining a doctor's practice qualification, illegally practices medicine, if the circumstances are serious, shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than three years, criminal detention or public surveillance, and shall also be fined or only be fined; if the act seriously impairs the health of a patient, he shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than three years but not more than ten years, and shall be fined; if the act causes the death of a patient, he shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than ten years, and shall be fined.
Whoever, without obtaining a doctor's practice qualification, performs a re-canalization operation of fertility, a fake fertility operation, a termination of pregnancy operation or an operation to remove intrauterine devices on another person without authorization, if the circumstances are serious, shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than three years, criminal detention or public surveillance, and shall also be fined or only be fined; if the act seriously impairs the health of a patient, he shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than three years but not more than ten years, and shall be fined; if the act causes the death of a patient, he shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than ten years, and shall be fined.
Article 336a Whoever implants a gene-edited or cloned human embryo into a human or animal body, or implants a gene-edited or cloned animal embryo into a human body, if the circumstances are serious, shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than three years or criminal detention, and shall be fined; if the circumstances are especially serious, he shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than three years but not more than seven years, and shall be fined.

Article 337 Whoever, in violation of the State regulations on animal and plant epidemic prevention and quarantine, causes a major animal or plant epidemic, or creates a risk of causing a major animal or plant epidemic, if the circumstances are serious, shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than three years or criminal detention, and shall also be fined or only be fined.
If a unit commits the crime as set forth in the preceding paragraph, it shall be fined, and the persons who are directly in charge and the other persons who are directly liable for the crime shall be punished in accordance with the provisions of the preceding paragraph.

Article 339 Whoever, in violation of the State regulations, brings solid waste from abroad into the territory of the People's Republic of China for dumping, piling up or disposing of it shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than five years or criminal detention, and shall be fined; if the act causes a major environmental pollution accident, resulting in heavy losses to public or private property or seriously endangering human health, he shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than five years but not more than ten years, and shall be fined; if the consequences are especially serious, he shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than ten years, and shall be fined.
Whoever, without permission of the relevant competent department under the State Council, imports solid waste as raw materials, thereby causing a major environmental pollution accident, resulting in heavy losses to public or private property or seriously endangering human health, shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than five years or criminal detention, and shall be fined; if the consequences are especially serious, he shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than five years but not more than ten years, and shall be fined.
Whoever, under the pretext of using it as raw material, imports solid waste, liquid waste or gaseous waste that cannot be used as raw materials shall be convicted and punished in accordance with the provisions of paragraph 2 and paragraph 3 of Article 152 of this Law.

Article 340 Whoever, in violation of the regulations on protection of aquatic resources, catches aquatic products in a forbidden fishing zone, during a forbidden fishing period or by using forbidden fishing gear or methods, if the circumstances are serious, shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than three years, criminal detention, public surveillance or a fine.

Article 341: Whoever illegally hunts or kills precious or endangered wildlife under special State protection, or illegally purchases, transports or sells such wildlife and the products thereof, shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than five years or criminal detention and shall also be fined; if the circumstances are serious, he shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than five years but not more than ten years and shall also be fined; if the circumstances are especially serious, he shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than ten years and shall also be fined or have his property confiscated.
Whoever, in violation of hunting laws and regulations, hunts in a closed hunting area, during a closed hunting season, or uses prohibited tools or methods, thus damaging wildlife resources, if the circumstances are serious, shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than three years, criminal detention, public surveillance or a fine.
Whoever, in violation of wildlife protection management laws and regulations, illegally hunts, purchases, transports, or sells, for the purpose of consumption, terrestrial wildlife that grows and reproduces naturally in the wild environment, other than that specified in the first paragraph, if the circumstances are serious, shall be punished in accordance with the provisions of the preceding paragraph.

Article 342: Whoever, in violation of land administration laws and regulations, illegally occupies agricultural land such as cultivated land or forest land, changes the use of the occupied land, if the area is relatively large and causes substantial damage to such agricultural land, shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than five years or criminal detention and shall also, or shall only, be fined.
Article 342a: Whoever, in violation of nature reserve management laws and regulations, engages in reclamation, development activities or builds structures in a national park or national-level nature reserve, causing serious consequences or having other egregious circumstances, shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than five years or criminal detention and shall also, or shall only, be fined.
If an act prescribed in the preceding paragraph also constitutes another crime, the person shall be convicted and punished in accordance with the provisions that impose a heavier punishment.

Article 343: Whoever, in violation of the provisions of the Mineral Resources Law, mines without a mining license, enters without authorization a mining area covered by State plans or of great value to the national economy or another person's mining area, or mines without authorization a specific mineral species for which protective mining is prescribed by the State, if the circumstances are serious, shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than three years, criminal detention or public surveillance and shall also, or shall only, be fined; if the circumstances are especially serious, he shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than three years but not more than seven years and shall also be fined.
Whoever, in violation of the provisions of the Mineral Resources Law, uses destructive mining methods to mine mineral resources, causing serious damage to mineral resources, shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than five years or criminal detention and shall also be fined.

Article 344: Whoever, in violation of State regulations, illegally fells or destroys precious trees or other plants under special State protection, or illegally purchases, transports, processes or sells precious trees or other plants under special State protection and the products thereof, shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than three years, criminal detention or public surveillance and shall also be fined; if the circumstances are serious, he shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than three years but not more than seven years and shall also be fined.
Article 344a: Whoever, in violation of State regulations, illegally introduces, releases or discards invasive alien species, if the circumstances are serious, shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than three years or criminal detention and shall also, or shall only, be fined.

Article 345: Whoever steals felled trees from forests or other woodlands, if the volume is relatively large, shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than three years, criminal detention or public surveillance and shall also, or shall only, be fined; if the volume is large, he shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than three years but not more than seven years and shall also be fined; if the volume is especially large, he shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than seven years and shall also be fined.
Whoever, in violation of the provisions of the Forest Law, destroys forests or other woodlands by excessive felling, if the volume is relatively large, shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than three years, criminal detention or public surveillance and shall also, or shall only, be fined; if the volume is large, he shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than three years but not more than seven years and shall also be fined.
Whoever illegally purchases or transports, knowing that the trees are stolen felled or excessively felled, if the circumstances are serious, shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than three years, criminal detention or public surveillance and shall also, or shall only, be fined; if the circumstances are especially serious, he shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than three years but not more than seven years and shall also be fined.
Whoever steals fells or excessively fells trees in forests or other woodlands within a national-level nature reserve shall be given a severe punishment.

Article 346: Where a unit commits the crimes prescribed in Articles 338 through 345 of this Section, the unit shall be fined, and the person directly in charge and other persons directly responsible shall be punished in accordance with the provisions of the respective articles of this Section.

Article 347: Whoever smuggles, traffics in, transports, or manufactures narcotic drugs, regardless of the quantity, shall be investigated for criminal liability and shall be subject to criminal punishment.
Whoever smuggles, traffics in, transports, or manufactures narcotic drugs under any of the following circumstances shall be sentenced to 15 years of fixed-term imprisonment, life imprisonment or the death penalty and shall also have their property confiscated:
(1) smuggling, trafficking, transporting or manufacturing more than 1,000 grams of opium, more than 50 grams of heroin or methamphetamine, or a large quantity of other narcotic drugs;
(2) being a ringleader of a drug smuggling, trafficking, transporting or manufacturing group;
(3) armed escort of the smuggling, trafficking, transporting or manufacturing of narcotic drugs;
(4) violently resisting inspection, detention or arrest under serious circumstances; or
(5) participating in organized international drug trafficking activities.
Whoever smuggles, traffics in, transports or manufactures more than 200 grams but less than 1,000 grams of opium, more than 10 grams but less than 50 grams of heroin or methamphetamine, or a relatively large quantity of other narcotic drugs shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than seven years and shall also be fined.
Whoever smuggles, traffics, transports or manufactures less than 200 grams of opium, less than 10 grams of heroin or methamphetamine, or small quantities of other narcotic drugs shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than three years, criminal detention or public surveillance and shall also be fined; if the circumstances are serious, he shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than three years but not more than seven years and shall also be fined.
Where a unit commits the crime prescribed in the second, third or fourth paragraph, the unit shall be fined, and the person directly in charge and other persons directly responsible shall be punished in accordance with the provisions of the respective paragraphs.
Whoever utilizes or instigates a minor to engage in the smuggling, trafficking, transporting or manufacturing of narcotic drugs or sells such drugs to a minor shall be given a severe punishment.
With respect to repeated offending where smuggling, trafficking, transporting or manufacturing of narcotic drugs has not been dealt with, the quantity of drugs shall be aggregated.

Article 348: Whoever illegally possesses more than 1,000 grams of opium, more than 50 grams of heroin or methamphetamine, or a large quantity of other narcotic drugs shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than seven years or life imprisonment and shall also be fined; whoever illegally possesses more than 200 grams but less than 1,000 grams of opium, more than 10 grams but less than 50 grams of heroin or methamphetamine, or a relatively large quantity of other narcotic drugs shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than three years, criminal detention or public surveillance and shall also be fined; if the circumstances are serious, he shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than three years but not more than seven years and shall also be fined.

Article 349: Whoever harbors a criminal who smuggles, traffics in, transports or manufactures narcotic drugs or whoever harbors, transfers or conceals drugs or the proceeds of crime for such a criminal shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than three years, criminal detention or public surveillance; if the circumstances are serious, he shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than three years but not more than ten years.
If a drug enforcement officer or other functionary of a State organ covers up or harbors a criminal who smuggles, traffics in, transports or manufactures narcotic drugs, they shall be given a severe punishment in accordance with the provisions of the preceding paragraph.
Whoever, having prior collusion, commits the crimes prescribed in the preceding two paragraphs shall be punished as an accomplice in the crime of smuggling, trafficking, transporting or manufacturing narcotic drugs.
